shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; ls; rg -n \"beforeSession|afterSession|onError\" src --glob '*test*'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; cat package.json; sed -n '1,160p' CHANGELOG.md; rg -n \"specs/|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -40; rg --files scripts/spec-links"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat src/transport/ws/subprotocol.test.ts; rg -n "function doc|const doc|spec anchor|tests.list|descriptor" scripts src | head -60; cat jest.config.js'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.test.ts | head -15; nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts | sed -n '138,160p'; git diff --check; git diff --stat; git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; git diff --no-index /dev/null src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.test.ts || true'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules timeout 300 npx jest --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrow.test.ts && git commit -m "Run lifecycle hooks when setup fails" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
